== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|A quicklamp is an alchemical lighting device consisting of a glass container filled with a glowing liquid formula. These devices provide a steady, bright light that can range in color from pure white and yellow to deep orange. Users can adjust the intensity of the illumination by manipulating an alchemical valve, and some versions are even bolted to walls with pull-cords for activation. While they are significantly more expensive than traditional candles or oil lanterns, they offer several practical advantages. The glass is tempered by [[Alchemists|alchemists]] to resist impacts, and the fluid itself is difficult to ignite and produces very little heat, making them much safer for use on ships or in confined spaces. However, they are not indestructible; they can be broken to release light and may ignite if struck by lightning or certain creatures. Because of their value and potential as weapons, they are closely inspected in high-security environments like prisons. Unlike thunderlights, which require lightning to recharge, [[quicklamps]] have a limited lifespan of several years before the fluid must be replaced.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A quicklamp serves as a functional source of light used by the crew, who gathered around one on the deck. These devices are utilized to illuminate various areas, including the hold and a cell. When in use, the quicklamp emits a light that is both steady and soft in an orange hue.}}
